packageRules.description: Hold System.CommandLine on the 2.0.0-beta4 API. The 2.0 GA removed the entire fluent builder surface AsicSharp.Cli/Program.cs is written against (InvokeAsync, SetHandler, the Argument/Option ctors), so bumping it fails the build. Re-enable once the CLI is migrated to the GA API.

Migrated off FluentAssertions to AwesomeAssertions (the free Apache-2.0 fork) because FluentAssertions v8+ is commercially licensed (Xceed). Guard against any accidental reintroduction of FluentAssertions pulling in the commercial line.
